title: Cang Yutian's Gaze
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to be crushed, a voice came from the depths of the Tianji Sword—Chen Tianming's voice: 'The time has come.'

text.content: The moment the eye in the depths of the Void slowly opened, Chen Ji felt as though something had completely seen through him. Not a gaze, but something far deeper, more primal. As if all his scheming, all his disguise, all the secrets hidden in the deepest corners of his heart were laid bare under the open sky. The Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled, and the thin barrier in his Mental Sea seemed to be gently touched by some force, emitting tiny crackling sounds.

dialogue.content: 'Interesting.' A voice rang directly in the depths of his consciousness, not passing through his eardrums, not vibrating through the air, yet clearer than any sound. That voice was ancient, primitive, carrying a suffocating majesty, like echoes from the primordial chaos. 'The new inheritor of the Tianji Record... more resilient than I anticipated.'

text.content: Chen Ji wanted to speak, but found his body completely immobile. Not bound—rather, some higher-dimensional existence had directly intervened in his neural transmission. That Cosmic Eye turned slightly, and within its pupil, stars were rotating, galaxies were flowing, countless civilizations were rising and falling. Then, that eye projected a beam of light. The luminous form coalesced into a vague humanoid figure, its features indistinct, but that posture of overlooking all beings was chillingly clear.

dialogue.content: 'You may call me Cang Yutian.' The voice continued, with an almost gentle tone, yet Chen Ji detected bone-deep chill within that gentleness. 'Not that this name matters much, but you must have some designation to face me. Do you wish to know who I am?'

text.content: Chen Ji finally regained a sliver of bodily control. He struggled to speak, his voice as hoarse as if squeezed through rock crevices: 'You... are the Ultimate Chess Player?' Cang Yutian's projection let out a gentle laugh. That laughter echoed within Chen Ji's consciousness, like countless blades simultaneously slicing through his mental defenses. Each hint of amusement carried an inexplicable mockery—not directed at Chen Ji, but at all insignificant beings.

dialogue.content: 'Ultimate Chess Player?' Cang Yutian's laughter gradually subsided, replaced by a deeper, more profound sigh. 'You always love using these terms. Ultimate, Chess Player, Creator, Heavenly Dao... these titles hold no meaning to me. I am neither a natural Chess Player nor the creator of the universe.' He paused, that Cosmic Eye narrowing slightly, as if lost in some distant memory. 'I am merely a projection of the Universe's Will, an executor chosen during a specific era. What you call the Ultimate Chess Player was not born into existence—rather, it embodies the manifestation of the Universe's Will.'

text.content: This sentence struck like a heavy hammer against Chen Ji's heart. Not a natural Chess Player. An incarnation of the Universe's Will. What did this mean? That everything he had been fighting against was not some concrete enemy, but a presence transcending individual will? That all his schemes, all his machinations, were merely jokes before the Universe's Will? The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently once more, and the fragments of information left by Chen Xuan surged frantically through his Mental Sea, as if warning him of something.

dialogue.content: 'You are afraid.' Cang Yutian's voice suddenly softened, like coaxing a frightened child. 'But you need not fear. I came today not to destroy you. Quite the opposite...' His projection drifted forward a step, and that oppressive pressure suddenly increased tenfold. Chen Ji felt his very soul trembling, fine cracks beginning to appear in his Mental Sea's spiritual barrier. 'I came to offer you an opportunity.'

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, summoning every ounce of his strength to keep his voice steady: 'What opportunity?' Cang Yutian's projection revealed a hint of a smile, and that smile seemed more terrifying to Chen Ji than any threat. 'Abandon the Third Path.' These four words landed like four loud slaps across Chen Ji's face. 'Abandon that road no one has walked, abandon your ridiculous ideals, abandon the things you are plotting. Then—' His voice suddenly became solemn and dignified: 'I may grant you eternal existence.'

Eternal existence. These four words echoed through Chen Ji's consciousness, stirring layered ripples. He understood what this meant. That he could transcend life and death, transcend reincarnation, transcend the constraints of Heavenly Dao's laws. That he could witness the fruits of his plotting bloom, that he could truly, eternally protect those he wished to protect. But— He thought of the look in Chen Nian's eyes when she turned back before disappearing. He thought of those blurry prophetic images within the Tianji Record Fragment. He thought of Ling Yuan's schemes, Han Lie's threats, and those enemies still waiting for him in the darkness. If he accepted, what would happen?

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian proposed a bargain: abandon the Third Path in exchange for eternal existence. A choice sufficient to change everything—Chen Ji had to decide.

choices.description: Eternal existence means one can forever protect those they love; perhaps this is the best ending
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Third Path, lose the chance to change Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Eternal existence, transcending life and death reincarnation
choices.risk_hint: Is this another trap? The Universe's Will's grace must surely have its price

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while. Within his Mental Sea, the fragments of information left by Chen Xuan surged wildly, as if protesting something. But those images were too blurry—he couldn't see clearly. And Cang Yutian's proposal was too tempting. 'I...'

choices.description: The Third Path is the last hope he left for Chen Nian, for everyone—it must not be abandoned
choices.visible_cost: Immediately incur the enmity of a cosmic-level existence
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independent will, preserve the possibility of changing destiny
choices.risk_hint: The price of refusing the Heavenly Will may be destruction

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That laughter echoed through the consciousness space, carrying a sense of resolve and mockery. 'Eternal existence?' His voice was hoarse but firm, 'If this eternal existence must be built on others' sacrifices, must be built on erasing the Third Path—'

choices.description: Not directly refuse, nor immediately agree; first clarify Cang Yutian's true intentions
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information about the Cosmic Will
choices.risk_hint: Negotiating with the Heavenly Dao Will is no different from bargaining with a tiger

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. He was all too familiar with this negotiating tactic—first dangling an enticing condition, letting the other party lose their reason in the face of enormous benefits, then step by step extracting more. "Before I answer," his voice regained its calm, "I want to know one thing."

The projection of Cang Yutian tilted its head slightly, as if becoming interested in Chen Ji's reaction. "Oh? What do you want to know?" The light from that Cosmic Eye became somewhat gentler, but Chen Ji knew this was merely a facade. The other party was not being merciful to him, but rather waiting for his performance in the manner of a cat toying with a mouse.

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, even though this action held no significance in the space of consciousness. "You claim to be an incarnation of the Cosmic Will. Then I want to know—" his voice was soft, yet every word was crystal clear, "—what was the final fate of the previous holders of the Tianji Record?" The air suddenly froze. Cang Yutian's projection stood motionless, the light from that Cosmic Eye turning abruptly icy and biting.

dialogue.content: Silence stretched for several breaths. Then Cang Yutian laughed. That laughter was no longer the previous mockery or condescension, but transformed into a pure, undisguised appreciation. "Good. Very good." His projection drifted backward a step, and that Cosmic Eye fully opened in the void. "You are different from them. The previous holders either lost their reason upon hearing the word 'eternity', or trembled beneath my might." He paused. "You are the first to ask me this question."

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, only watching Cang Yutian quietly. He knew the other would continue. Such beings, especially those claiming to be incarnations of the Cosmic Will, loved nothing more than displaying their vast knowledge and sense of control. As expected, Cang Yutian continued: "The fates of the Tianji Record holders throughout history varied. Some died in heavenly tribulation, some fell in sect conflicts, some perished exhausted while pursuing the truth." His voice grew deeper. "But the true reason for their demise was only one—they all, at some point, touched a forbidden taboo that should never have been touched."

"Taboo?" Chen Ji's voice was soft. Cang Yutian's projection smiled faintly. "For instance, attempting to glimpse the true origin of the Tianji Record. For instance, trying to find the truth behind the previous holders' disappearances. For instance—" His voice suddenly turned ice-cold. "—attempting to challenge the established order of the universe." The light from that Cosmic Eye abruptly became blinding, and Chen Ji felt his mental barriers nearly collapse in that instant. "And you, Chen Ji—" Cang Yutian's voice descended like from the nine heavens, "—are retracing their footsteps."

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian revealed the tragic fates of the previous Tianji Record holders and implied Chen Ji was following their doomed path. This was a critical moment where Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Since things have come this far, there is no reason to turn back. Keep asking and see how much truth can be uncovered
choices.visible_cost: Immediately become a target of the Cosmic Will
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information about the origin of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The more one knows, the greater the danger

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into wild laughter. That laughter echoed through the consciousness space, carrying a reckless audacity. "Retracing their footsteps?" His voice dripped with mockery, "If I am destined to die, then at least let me die knowing why!"

choices.description: Retreat to advance—pretend to accept the deal's terms, actually to preserve strength and seek opportunities
choices.visible_cost: Need to utter compromising words that go against one's heart
choices.visible_reward: Preserve living forces and buy time
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian might see through his disguise

dialogue.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long time. When he spoke again, his voice carried a despondency he almost convinced even himself was genuine: "...I need time to consider."

Cang Yutian's projection watched Chen Ji silently for a moment. That gaze contained too many things—scrutiny, amusement, and a faint trace of... satisfaction? "You are a wise man, Chen Ji." His voice softened, like an elder guiding a junior. "A wise man should understand one truth: the further you walk down some paths, the harder it becomes to turn back. Every step you take now determines your future destiny."

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing. He knew that Cang Yutian was waiting for his answer, but he also knew that no matter what he said, the other party had already made their own judgment. This was merely a formality of "giving a chance." Like a cat toying with a mouse—occasionally releasing its claws to let the prey run a few steps before pouncing again. But Chen Ji was no mouse. In the depths of his eyes, something was gently burning.

dialogue.content: "I will give you one more chance." Cang Yutian's voice suddenly turned ice-cold, and the light of that Cosmic Eye intensified tenfold. "Accept my proposal, abandon the Third Path. You will gain eternal existence and become the new guardian of this world." He paused. "Refuse me—" The eye's light abruptly turned violent, and an apocalyptic pressure instantly engulfed Chen Ji's entire consciousness space. "And you will be obliterated today."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his spiritual barrier burst into countless cracks in that instant. The pressure didn't come from outside but from the universe's laws themselves. He felt as if the entire heavens and earth were rejecting him, all things despising him, fate abandoning him. Was this the power of a cosmic-level existence? Even the projection's oppressive might was almost more than he could bear. If the true form descended—he didn't dare to imagine. But—he thought of Chen Nian. Of his sister waiting in darkness for rescue. Of why he had chosen the Third Path in the first place.

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian delivered his final ultimatum—accept the deal, or face destruction. It was a choice with no retreat.

choices.description: The Third Path was the final hope he offered to Chen Nian, to everyone—he would die standing
choices.visible_reward: Preserve complete integrity and the spark of the Third Path
choices.risk_hint: Challenge the Cosmic Will with a mortal body, nine deaths and one life

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled. It was an extremely calm smile, devoid of fear, devoid of anger—only a serenity that saw through everything. "Cang Yutian—or should I call you the puppet of the Cosmic Will?" His voice echoed through the consciousness space, every word crystal clear. "Do you know why I chose the Third Path?"

choices.description: Pretend to accept, but propose a condition that Cang Yutian cannot accept, forcing the other party to strike first and reveal more of their trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Gather more information, buy time waiting for unexpected variables
choices.risk_hint: Playing tricks against the Heavenly Will is extremely risky

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath. "Very well. I accept your proposal." Cang Yutian's projection paused slightly, seemingly surprised by this answer. "But—" Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned sharp, "I have one condition."

Cang Yutian's projection said nothing, merely waiting in silence. The light of that Cosmic Eye stabilized, as if granting Chen Ji final patience. Chen Ji felt his heart racing, but he forced himself to remain calm. He knew that every word he spoke now could determine his life or death. "My condition is—" He paused, organizing his thoughts. Suddenly, a faint fluctuation came from the depths of his Mental Sea. That was—

text.content: Chen Ji's words cut off abruptly. He felt that fluctuation. Very faint, very blurry, but undeniably real. It was neither the Tianji Record Fragment's fluctuation nor the information fragment left by Chen Xuan. Was it—the Heavenly Secret Sword? No. It was from somewhere deeper. Someone he thought had been completely dormant was slowly awakening. Cang Yutian's projection seemed to sense something too, the light of that Cosmic Eye flickering slightly. "Interesting," he murmured. "It seems there are still some secrets on you that I don't know about."

Chen Ji did not answer. Because he didn't know what was happening either. But he knew he no longer needed to make a choice. Because a certain change was occurring. Within the depths of the Heavenly Secret Sword, the existence that had slumbered for so long was slowly opening its eyes. And that voice— "The time has come." Low, ancient, carrying a remoteness that traversed countless ages. It was Chen Tianming's voice. Chen Ji's eyes grew moist. "Master..."

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian's projection suddenly froze. The light of that Cosmic Eye fluctuated for the first time, no longer the high-and-mighty scrutiny from before, but carrying a hint of... wariness? "Chen Tianming?" His voice carried uncertainty for the first time. "Impossible. He should have long—" Before he could finish, an even more massive power erupted from the depths of the Heavenly Secret Sword. That power was vast, ancient, carrying an entirely different aura from the Cosmic Will. It was creation. It was hope. It was the core of the Third Path.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his body enveloped by a warm power. Those精神屏障 that had been on the verge of collapse began healing, and the consciousness suppressed by the Cosmic Eye became active again. He heard Chen Tianming's voice, but not the weak, fragmented whispers from before—it was complete, clear guidance: "Child, you've done well." "But the road ahead, let me walk it." "It's time—" "To show him what a true Chess Player looks like."
Just as Chen Ji was about to be crushed, Chen Tianming's voice came from the depths of the Heavenly Secret Sword: "The time has come."
